prior_sql_and_feedback.question: What is the total net order value among orders for customers currently in the South region? SELECT SUM(o.c_jnqbsy * o.c_bnwrus - COALESCE(refs.total_refunds, 0)) AS total_net_value
FROM r_tiwwww o
INNER JOIN r_fzayqu p ON o.c_nysqat = p.c_rvmczc
LEFT JOIN (

    FROM r_asismm
    GROUP BY c_bpiywr

view.reconstruction_sql: SELECT AVG("sv_reconstruct"."m0") AS "avg_net_value" FROM (SELECT "o"."c_vracnj" AS "c0", "o"."c_nysqat" AS "c1", "o"."c_jnqbsy" AS "c2", "o"."c_bnwrus" AS "c3", "o"."c_qvdfnp" AS "c4", "o"."c_nxpehr" AS "c5", "o"."c_njrvnt" AS "c6", "refs"."c_bpiywr" AS "c7", "refs"."total_refunds" AS "c8", "o"."c_jnqbsy" * "o"."c_bnwrus" - COALESCE("refs"."total_refunds", 0) AS "m0" FROM "r_tiwwww" AS "o" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "r_asismm"."c_bpiywr" AS "c_bpiywr", SUM("r_asismm"."c_xfjbdw") AS "total_refunds" FROM "r_asismm" AS "r_asismm" GROUP BY "r_asismm"."c_bpiywr") AS "refs" ON "o"."c_vracnj" = "refs"."c_bpiywr" WHERE "o"."c_qvdfnp" = :sv_text_0 AND NOT "o"."c_jnqbsy" IS NULL) AS "sv_reconstruct"
view.source_sql:
SELECT AVG(o.c_jnqbsy * o.c_bnwrus - COALESCE(refs.total_refunds, 0)) AS avg_net_value
FROM r_tiwwww o
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c_bpiywr, SUM(c_xfjbdw) AS total_refunds
    FROM r_asismm
    GROUP BY c_bpiywr
) refs ON o.c_vracnj = refs.c_bpiywr
WHERE o.c_qvdfnp = 'cancelled'
  AND o.c_jnqbsy IS NOT NULL
